reports.title: Siberian Cult Leader Thinks He's Jesus
reports.description: Deep in Siberia's Taiga forest is Vissarion, a cult leader who looks like Jesus and claims to be the voice of God. He's known as "the Teacher" to his 4,000 followers, who initially seem surprisingly normal. Over time, however, their unflinching belief in UFOs and the Earth's imminent demise made this group start to look more and more like some sort of strange cult.Hosted by Rocco Castoro | Originally released in 2011 at [URL REMOVED]Follow Rocco on Twitter: [URL REMOVED]Read the full Jesus of Siberia article here: [URL REMOVED]Watch more VICE documentaries here: [URL REMOVED]Subscribe for videos that are actually good: [URL REMOVED]Check out our full video catalog: [URL REMOVED]Videos, daily editorial and more: [URL REMOVED]Like VICE on Facebook: [URL REMOVED]Follow VICE on Twitter: [URL REMOVED]Read our tumblr: [URL REMOVED]
